customer: Small studio / freelancer buying SaaS, established in Sweden

rules.title: Mutual liability cap
rules.position: Each party's aggregate liability is capped at 100% of the fees paid in the 12 months preceding the claim. The cap must be mutual and must not be undermined by carve-outs that apply only to the Customer.
fallback_positions: Cap of 150% of annual fees if the counterparty insists
Unlimited liability only for wilful misconduct, gross negligence, and IP infringement by either party
never_accept: Unlimited liability for the Customer
A cap that protects only the Provider
Carve-outs that remove the cap for the Customer's indemnity or ordinary breach while keeping it for the Provider
rules.preferred_language: Each party's aggregate liability arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall not exceed the total Fees paid or payable by Customer in the twelve (12) months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. This limitation applies equally to both parties and to all claims, including indemnification obligations, except for liability arising from wilful misconduct, gross negligence, or infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights.

rules.title: Renewal terms and notice
rules.position: Renewal periods no longer than the initial term and never longer than 12 months. Non-renewal notice of at most 30 days before the end of the term.
fallback_positions: Notice period of up to 60 days if the renewal period is 12 months or shorter
never_accept: Renewal periods longer than 12 months
Notice periods longer than 60 days
Renewal with a price increase not disclosed before the notice deadline
rules.preferred_language: This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive periods of twelve (12) months unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current Term.

rules.title: Data location and DPA
rules.position: Customer Data is stored and processed within the EU/EEA. Transfers outside the EU/EEA only under a data processing agreement with standard contractual clauses, with prior written notice of new subprocessors and a right to object.
fallback_positions: Processing in an adequacy-decision country with a DPA in place
US processing under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework with a DPA and 30 days' notice of subprocessor changes
never_accept: Processing in any country at Provider's discretion
No obligation to notify subprocessor or location changes
No DPA
rules.preferred_language: Customer Data shall be stored and processed within the European Economic Area. Provider shall not transfer Customer Data outside the EEA without Customer's prior written consent and a data processing agreement incorporating the EU standard contractual clauses, and shall give Customer at least thirty (30) days' written notice of any new subprocessor or change of processing location, during which Customer may object.

rules.title: Payment terms, late fees, refunds
rules.position: Net 30 payment terms. Late interest at the statutory rate under the Swedish Interest Act or at most 1.5% per month. Suspension only after 30 days overdue and written notice. Prepaid fees refunded pro rata if Customer terminates for Provider's breach. No price changes during a committed term.
fallback_positions: Net 14 with late interest at 1.5% per month
Price increases of at most 5% per year, notified 60 days before renewal
never_accept: Fees non-refundable even where Provider is in breach
Suspension without notice
Price changes taking effect during the current term
Interest above 2% per month
rules.preferred_language: Fees are payable within thirty (30) days of the invoice date. Overdue amounts accrue interest in accordance with the Swedish Interest Act (1975:635). Provider may suspend the Service only if an undisputed amount remains unpaid thirty (30) days after written notice. If Customer terminates this Agreement for Provider's material breach, Provider shall refund any prepaid Fees for the remainder of the Term on a pro rata basis. Fees are fixed for the duration of each Term.

rules.title: Ownership of Customer Data and derivatives
rules.position: Customer owns Customer Data and everything derived from it, including aggregated or anonymised datasets. Provider receives only a licence to host and process Customer Data to provide the Service. Feedback may be licensed to Provider non-exclusively, never assigned.
fallback_positions: Provider may use fully anonymised, aggregated statistics that cannot identify Customer, for improving the Service only
never_accept: Assignment of derivative works of Customer Data to Provider
Use of Customer Data for any purpose
Assignment of Feedback
rules.preferred_language: Customer retains all rights, title and interest in Customer Data, including any derivative works, analyses and datasets created from it. Provider may use Customer Data solely to provide the Service. Customer grants Provider a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence to use any Feedback for the purpose of improving the Service.

rules.title: Confidentiality term and scope
rules.position: Mutual confidentiality obligations lasting 3 years after termination; trade secrets protected for as long as they remain trade secrets. Standard exceptions (public, already known, independently developed, legally required disclosure).
never_accept: Perpetual confidentiality for all information (unclear and hard to enforce under Swedish law)
One-sided obligations
No exception for legally required disclosure
rules.preferred_language: The obligations in this Section 6 survive for three (3) years after termination of this Agreement, except that trade secrets shall be protected for as long as they remain trade secrets under applicable law.
red_flags: survive termination of this agreement forever

rules.title: Termination rights and data export
rules.position: Either both parties may terminate for convenience with equal notice of at least 60 days, or neither may. Either party may terminate for material breach after a 30-day cure period. Customer may export Customer Data for at least 30 days after termination.
fallback_positions: Provider convenience termination with at least 90 days' notice and a pro rata refund
never_accept: Provider may terminate for convenience on short notice while Customer is locked in for the term
Suspension or termination without notice
Data deleted immediately on termination
rules.preferred_language: Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty (60) days' written notice, in which case Provider shall refund any prepaid Fees for the unexpired part of the Term on a pro rata basis. Either party may terminate this Agreement if the other party materially breaches it and fails to cure the breach within thirty (30) days of written notice.

rules.title: Scope of indemnities
rules.position: Customer indemnifies only for third-party claims caused by Customer Data that is unlawful or infringes third-party rights, or by Customer's breach of applicable law. Provider indemnifies for IP infringement by the Service. Both indemnities are subject to the liability cap except for IP infringement.
fallback_positions: Customer indemnity also covers Customer's material breach of the acceptable use policy
never_accept: Customer indemnifies for 'any use of the Service' or 'any breach of this Agreement'
Customer indemnity excluded from the liability cap while Provider's is not
Provider IP indemnity conditioned on Provider having 'sole control' with no Customer participation right
rules.preferred_language: Customer shall defend and indemnify Provider against third-party claims to the extent arising from Customer Data that infringes a third party's intellectual property rights or violates applicable law. Provider shall defend and indemnify Customer against third-party claims alleging that the Service infringes a third party's intellectual property rights. Each party's indemnification obligations are subject to Section 8, except for claims of intellectual property infringement.

rules.preferred_language: This Agreement may be amended only by a written instrument signed by both parties. Provider may update its documentation and acceptable use policy on thirty (30) days' written notice, provided that no such update materially degrades the Service or Customer's rights.
